notes: DonationVault binds LaunchToken at construction. Neither contract has an owner or admin, and no initialization calls are needed. Users approve then donate to create public gifts; the first wallet other than the donor to claim receives the full gift. Donor points include fractions and persist after payout. Points measure gross donations and can be farmed with a second wallet; they do not prove net giving. Direct token transfers to the vault create no gift or points and remain locked. The factory supplies the native ETH/testAdam pool, MerkleDistributor and initialization-only pool guard.
